name: Config entity reference selection
description: Derives an EntityReferenceSelection plugin per config entity type so a field can be limited to a chosen subset of that type.
project_description:
This goal of this project is to allow site builders to configure subsets of configuration entities that can be selected by entity reference fields -- leading to a simplified user experience for content editors.

 
 How does it work? 
 This module derives an Entity Reference Selection plugin for every configuration entity type available on a site. The plugin allows site builders to provide a more granular list of options to end-users.

 A compelling use case 
 Imagine that a content type has an entity reference field for a Webform. Content editors are supposed to pick from one of three webforms to include on the content item...however there are over 200 webforms on the site to choose from!

 With this module installed and configured, only the relevant Webforms will be presented as options to the content editor.
